title: Primary Plated Round
summary: Primary Plated Round is an Arcane Enhancement for primary weapons that increases primary weapon damage for a short duration when reloading a depleted magazine from the equipped primary weapon.
extract:
Primary Plated Round is an Arcane Enhancement for primary weapons that increases primary weapon damage for a short duration when reloading a depleted magazine from the equipped primary weapon.

Effect

Acquisition
Primary Plated Round can be obtained from Mirror Defense as a Rotation B reward. Alternatively it can be purchased from Otak for 60  Belric Crystal Fragment and  Rania Crystal Fragment each, for a total of 1,260 of each for max rank.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Only activates upon refilling of the primary weapon magazine.
Some reloads replenish their magazine before the reload time is finished, where the arcane may prematurely activate. For example  Prisma Gorgon refills at ~4/5 of its reload time, where it may lose about 0.5 seconds of the arcane's duration before it can even fire.
Cannot activate off of weapons with battery magazines such as  Flux Rifle,  Bubonico or Kitguns equipped with  Pax Charge.
Can be equipped on Bows, but will not have any effect.
Maximum damage bonus is calculated by the following:Max Damage Bonus=15⋅5⋅Magazine Size
Bonus is additive to base damage such as  Serration.
Some example results are:
33.5% bonus from a 1-round magazine.
75% bonus from a 5-round magazine.
88.7% bonus from a 7-round magazine, almost matching either  Point Blank or  Vicious Spread at max rank.
Weapon that consume 1 ammo per shot must have at least 0.7 Fire Rate to make use of 10-second buff on all shots in continuous fire. For continuous weapons, which fire 0.5 ammo per shot, at least 1.4 Fire Rate instead.
100.6% bonus from a 9-round magazine.
150% bonus from a 20-round magazine.
167.7% bonus from a 25-round magazine, matching either  Serration,  Heavy Caliber, or  Primed Point Blank at max rank.
Weapon that consume 1 ammo per shot must have at least 2.5 Fire Rate to make use of 10-second buff on all shots in continuous fire. For 0.5 ammo per shot weapons, at least 5.0 Fire Rate instead.
201.2% bonus from a 36-round magazine.
300% bonus from a 80-round magazine, matching  Arcane Primary Charger at max rank.
Weapon that consume 1 ammo per shot must have at least 8.0 Fire Rate to make use of 10-second buff on all shots in continuous fire. For 0.5 ammo per shot weapons, at least 16.0 Fire Rate instead.
361.2% bonus from a 116-round magazine, matching  Primary Deadhead,  Primary Dexterity, and  Primary Merciless at max stacks at max rank.
Weapon that consume 1 ammo per shot must have at least 11.6 Fire Rate to make use of 10-second buff on all shots in continuous fire. For 0.5 ammo per shot weapons, at least 23.2 Fire Rate instead.
474.3% bonus from a 200-round magazine.
530.3% bonus from a 250-round magazine.
580.9% bonus from a 300-round magazine.
Partial reloads grant only a partial bonus, scaling with the amount of ammunition reloaded:Partial Damage Bonus=(Magazine Size - Leftover Ammunition)(Magazine Size)⋅15⋅5⋅Magazine Size
For example, reloading only 40 bullets of a 80 magazine (50% of the magazine) will grant 150% bonus damage (50% of the bonus).
The partial reload multiplier has directly linear scaling and the magazine size bonus scales logarithmically (lower than directly linear), meaning that reloading a given amount of ammunition will give a better bonus when it is near the magazine size.
For example, a completely empty 40-round magazine will grant a 212% bonus, but reloading 40 rounds into an 80-round magazine will only grant a 150% bonus, and into a 120-round magazine, only a 122% bonus.
Mods such as Tactical Reload and Synth Mods will cause this arcane to lose most of its effect if the weapon gets holstered, because they are coded as frequent single-round reloads, and will continually overwrite any existing Plated Round buffs with very small partial reload buffs until the magazine is full.
Activating the Incarnon Form of an Incarnon weapon activates the arcane, but deactivation does not.
This is because an Incarnon transformation simultaneously performs a reload of the weapon's base magazine.
The bonus granted after an Incarnon transformation scales with size of the base magazine and the amount of ammunition reloaded to it, rather than the number of Incarnon Charges.
Can be equipped on 1-round magazines such as  Tonkor.

Tips
Unlike other Arcanes that require an active target or even a kill to trigger, Primary Plated Round's activation is entirely within the player's control and can be prepared in advance of an engagement such as boss fights.
Picking up  Cyte-09's  Resupply ammo packs triggers Primary Plated Round.
Reloading via  Garuda's  Blood Forge triggers Primary Plated Round.
Performs best on weapons with above-average magazine sizes (120 rounds or more) that also consume the magazine quickly enough to benefit from the bonus during its brief, 10-second duration. This strategy is very tolling on a weapon's ammunition, so ammo pickups should be considered.
See Weapon Comparison/Primary for a complete list of primary weapons, sortable by magazine size.
Ammo Mutation and Scavenger mods are recommended, as is  Ammo Case. Abilities such as  Dispensary (which can be transferred via the Helminth) or  Resupply may also be considered.
 Kohm (with 245 rounds) and  Kuva Kohm (with 209 rounds) have only average fire rates (roughly 3.67 and 4.17 respectively when fully spooled), but consume 4 ammo per shot at full spool. Shotguns also have the strongest magazine bonus available with  Primed Ammo Stock, but the ammo pickup for both guns is only 40, making it difficult to sustain without using Squad Ammo Restores or similar mechanics.
 Quellor's primary fire mode (6.00) is slow to unload its 300-round magazine, but the Alternate Fire will consume 50 ammo per shot at a rate of 0.45 shots/sec, depleting the magazine in 13.2 seconds without modding fire rate.
Similarly,  Trumna's 200-round magazine is hindered by its slow primary fire rate of 4.67, but can prepare a reload for a devastating alt-fire attack.
 Prisma Grakata has 120 rounds in the magazine and a very high fire rate of 21.67.  Wild Frenzy also helps the Prisma Grakata empty out its magazine very quickly, and the damage boost from this Arcane makes it easy to trigger the augment's ammo refund.
A  Primary Rattleguts kitgun with the Macro Arcroid loader (providing 153 rounds) can be crafted with either the Shrewd (14), Palmaris (15.5), or Brash (17) grips, emptying the magazine in 10 seconds on average.
See Fire Rate for ways to increase weapon fire rate so that the weapon can make full use of the 10-second damage buff.
